items.title: PB Fintech loses Rs 42,000 cr in 7 sessions, hits 32-month low
items.description: PB Fintech, the parent company of Policybazaar, has seen a significant decline in its stock value. Following a consultation paper from Irdai proposing caps on distributor commissions, the stock price has plummeted. The market capitalisation fell from ₹87,290 crore to ₹45,174 crore over the past seven sessions. This decline represents a loss of over 48% during this period. The stock is back at its initial public offering price of ₹980.

items.title: Stocks in news: Vedanta, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Marico, Axis Bank, Trent and Zydus Lifesciences
items.description: Indian equity markets showed signs of recovery on Monday after softer-than-expected US jobs data was released. The Nifty 50 index ended the session up, suggesting improved investor confidence. Investors are watching key corporate updates from companies like Vedanta and Kotak Mahindra Bank for future trends. Firms reported various operational advancements and financial performance improvements for the quarter. The overall sentiment in the market remains cautiously optimistic amid external economic influences.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: The stock market's positive open saw the Nifty rise by 0.6%, breaking an eight-week streak of losses. Experts note a potential rebound in Indian stocks, driven by favorable Q2 business reports and strong bank results. However, the rupee suffered as it depreciated against the US dollar amid escalating oil prices and exiting foreign funds.

items.title: Stock Radar: Engineers India stock hits fresh record high in September after decisive breakout; time to buy?
items.description: Engineers India Ltd broke out from two years of consolidation to reach a record high in September 2026. The company's stock has risen more than 11% in a month and over 30% in the last three months. Analysts suggest that short-term traders can consider buying the stock for potential targets above 330 levels. The technical setup indicates strong bullish momentum and potential upside towards 335 to 345 levels.

items.title: National Housing Bank likely to double affordable housing outlay for HFCs this fiscal
items.description: National Housing Bank plans to double the refinance and affordable housing funds for large housing finance companies. These funds will be available to companies seeking long-term and cheaper financing options. LIC Housing Finance, Bajaj Housing Finance, and others are likely to benefit from this increase. The funding is expected to help reduce reliance on banks while promoting growth in housing loans.

items.title: Viceroy Hotels shares rise 2% as Zerodha founders Nithin, Nikhil Kamath pick 6.72% stake
items.description: Viceroy Hotels shares witnessed an uptick on Tuesday after Zerodha founders Nithin and Nikhil Kamath acquired a 6.72% stake in the company during the September quarter. The hotel operator, which emerged from insolvency in 2024, is expanding its portfolio in Hyderabad and has plans to acquire SLN Terminus Hotels and Resorts.

items.title: NSE shares wipe off Rs 41,000 crore after listing day pop as stock slips below IPO price. Why are analysts still bullish?
items.description: NSE shares have slipped below their IPO price after a brief listing-day rally, wiping out nearly Rs 41,000 crore from the exchange’s peak market value. Despite the decline, analysts remain bullish, citing NSE’s dominant market position, strong profitability, cash generation and India’s long-term capital-market growth potential.

items.title: Festive season bets: Analysts see upside in Lenskart, Arvind, Varun Beverages and 3 other stocks
items.description: D-Street investors eyeing tactical gains during the festive season may want to keep six stocks on their radar: Lenskart, Arvind, Varun Beverages, OMNI, IT BeES and Sudarshan Chemical Industries, as analysts see potential upside in these counters.Investors looking to make stock-market bets during the festive season can consider Lenskart, Arvind, Varun Beverages, OMNI, IT BeES and Sudarshan Chemical Industries, as analysts see potential upside in these six stocks based on their fundamental and technical outlook.

items.title: AWL Agri Business shares climb 4% as Q2 revenue rises 24% YoY,  Food & FMCG posts record quarterly revenue
items.description: AWL Agri Business shares rose nearly 4% after Q2 revenue grew 24% year-on-year, driven by strong performance in Food & FMCG and Industry Essentials. Food & FMCG revenue jumped 33%, surpassing Rs 2,000 crore. Pulses, exports, e-commerce and specialty chemicals also recorded robust growth, while edible oils posted steady volume gains.

items.title: Newly-listed Steamhouse India shares hit 10% circuit after Q1 net profit rises 80% to Rs 18 crore
items.description: Newly-listed Steamhouse India shares hit the 10% upper circuit after the company reported an 80.25% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 18 crore. Revenue from operations rose 13.35% to Rs 129 crore, while margins improved 700 basis points to 24.05% during the quarter.

items.title: How Jefferies is reshuffling its portfolio as soaring bond yields give Nifty bulls sleepless nights
items.description: Jefferies is favouring largecaps as rising bond yields pressure Indian equities, citing relatively attractive valuations and a narrowing earnings gap with midcaps. The brokerage has added Kotak Mahindra Bank and Reliance Industries to its preferred portfolio.

items.title: Rs 17,540 crore added to Trent mcap, but Citi stays bearish. Why Morgan Stanley disagrees
items.description: Trent shares surged 13% after the Tata Group retailer reported strong Q2 revenue growth and crossed the 1,000-store milestone for Zudio. Morgan Stanley and HSBC remain bullish, while Citi stays cautious over margins, competition and revenue per square foot.

items.title: Jefferies, Nomura and  Macquarie initiate coverage on 5 stocks with up to 30% upside potential. See full list
items.description: A host of domestic and global brokerages have initiated coverage on select Indian stocks across sectors such as travel and consumer discretionary. Analysts are bullish on names including Trent and IndiGo and see strong upside from current levels. Here are five stocks that recently received brokerage coverage.

items.title: Sugar stocks Balrampur Chini, Dhampur Sugar, others rally up to 8%. What’s behind the uptick?
items.description: Sugar stocks, including Balrampur Chini, Dhampur Sugar and EID Parry, rallied sharply on Tuesday as raw sugar futures remained near two-year highs. Rising supply concerns in Brazil, Europe and Thailand, along with stronger festive-season demand, have lifted expectations of tighter global sugar supplies and supported the recent rally.

items.title: From Rs 0 to GIFT: How TPFM is lowering the entry barrier for fund managers
items.description: Third-Party Fund Management Services under IFSCA regulations are transforming market entry into GIFT IFSC. By allowing emerging managers to utilize existing Fund Management Entities, TPFM lowers fixed infrastructure costs, shifting focus from building platforms upfront to raising fund capital and accessing established regulatory framework capabilities efficiently.

items.title: How a 9-year-old Warren Buffett learnt a lesson on compounding by rolling snowballs on the lawn of his Nebraska home
items.description: Warren Buffett's journey into the world of compounding began in his childhood while he rolled snowballs in Nebraska. He drew parallels between attracting opportunities and how snowballs accumulate snow, illustrating that small investments can flourish significantly when approached correctly. Recently, he stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, entrusting leadership to his son, reflecting on his illustrious career and his unwavering faith in the company’s future.

items.title: Explained: How RBI rate hike may impact Sensex, Nifty after 8-week losing streak
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to announce a 25-basis point rate hike in its upcoming meeting. Analysts assert that this rate hike has already been largely priced into the stock market. While sectors such as real estate and autos may experience some volatility, clean balance sheets could mitigate impacts. The market's movement will depend more on corporate earnings than on monetary policy adjustments.

items.title: Acme Universal Safezone 9 debuts 42% premium on BSE SME; Pind Hospitality opens at 20% discount. Check details
items.description: Three SME IPOs — Pind Hospitality, Acme Universal Safezone 9 and Shivchem Agro — made their debut on the BSE SME platform on October 6. Together, the companies raised nearly Rs 68 crore through their IPOs, with subscription levels ranging from 2.20 times to 23.41 times.

items.title: Adani Power gains 2% after signing pact for 770-MW hydropower project in Bhutan
items.description: Adani Power shares gained 2% after the company signed a pact with Bhutan’s Druk Green Power Corporation to develop the 770-MW Chamkharchhu hydropower project. The ₹project will be developed through a 49:51 partnership, with construction expected to begin in the first half of 2027. The project is part of a broader 5,000-MW hydropower development programme.

items.title: Rentomojo shares rally 6% after Q1 revenue rises 51%, normalised PAT grows 72% YoY
items.description: Rentomojo shares rallied after the company's first earnings report since its listing last month, which showed revenue up 50% year-on-year to Rs 126 crore in Q1 FY27. EBITDA rose to Rs 51 crore from Rs 34 crore, with margins st

items.title: Honasa Consumer shares jump 7% as Q2 operating update points to strong growth
items.description: Honasa Consumer shares rallied after the company projected strong Q2 FY27 operating performance, with net sales growth expected in the early thirties, improving margins and continued traction across brands and offline channels.

items.title: Titan Q2FY27 update: Consumer businesses grow 25% YoY, jewellery up 21%
items.description: Titan Company’s consumer businesses grew 25% year-on-year in Q2 FY27, led by watches, EyeCare and jewellery. Domestic businesses rose 22%, while international operations surged 97%. Titan added 78 net stores, taking its overall consumer store network to 3,758 in September 2026.

items.title: Investor awareness key to long-term wealth creation, technology double-edged sword: ANMI President Kamlesh Shroff
items.description: Investor education in India is vital for effective market participation and wealth accumulation. The trend of younger investors signifies a promising advantage for early market entry. Nonetheless, the escalating prevalence of online financial scams threatens investor assets. SEBI highlights capital protection through regulated investment pathways and stresses the necessity for investors to cautiously validate the legitimacy of entities before making fund transfers, thereby mitigating scam risks.

items.title: HFCL among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rallied up to 15% in a month
items.description: Benchmark Sensex gained 685 points to close at 73,067. Amid the market rally, four stocks from the BSE 500 Index touched fresh 52-week highs, marking their highest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous year and can indicate increased market activity and investor interest.

items.title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Q2 disbursements jump 55% YoY to Rs 3,525 crore; loan portfolio rises over 7%
items.description: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank’s Q2 FY27 disbursements surged 54.9% year-on-year to Rs 3,525 crore, driven by strong non-JLG growth. Total loans rose 7.5% to Rs 20,063 crore, while deposits increased 6.6% to Rs 23,869 crore, according to provisional business data.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Where is smart money moving amid global market churn?
items.description: As global capital shifts amid rising bond yields, changing valuations and new investment themes, investors are asking where the next opportunities could emerge. At ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0, two back-to-back sessions will explore where long-term capital is moving and how family offices and institutions are putting money to work across private credit, venture debt, co-investments and alternative strategies.

items.title: Market wrap: Trent, BSE, Coal India, Tech Mahindra top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
items.description: Franklin India Small Cap Fund crossed Rs 14,000 crore in AUM, while a Rs 10,000 monthly SIP grew to nearly Rs 1.94 crore over 20 years. The fund has outperformed its benchmark over 15 years, highlighting long-term compounding and disciplined investing.

items.title: Reliance Industries shares gain 3% as JIO IPO inches closer; Jefferies increases weight in conglomerate
items.description: Reliance Industries is preparing for the IPO of Jio Platforms scheduled to launch on October 21. The valuation of Jio Platforms is reported at Rs 11 lakh crore, making it highly anticipated. The public issue is expected to attract significant attention as it opens for subscription. Jefferies has raised its weight on Reliance Industries due to attractive valuations amid improving conditions.

items.title: Sebi says Jane Street’s appeal for more details a delaying ploy
items.description: Sebi has called Jane Street’s demand for additional documents a “dilatory” tactic as the Wall Street trading firm challenges the regulator’s market manipulation allegations. The dispute centres on Jane Street’s trading in Nifty Bank derivatives. The outcome could influence how global trading firms assess regulatory risks in India’s derivatives market, with the hearing set to continue Wednesday.

items.title: Looking beyond 2026: 5 mid-cap stocks from different sectors with upside potential of up to 22%
items.description: After a long run of red days, the screen finally turned green on Tuesday. And for once it is not just the big names, the broader market joined in too. One or two companies have put out early numbers for the quarter, and those have been better than expected. After weeks of watching stocks drop, it is the most natural thing in the world to look at a day like this and feel that the worst is behind us. That would be a mistake, however.

items.title: CAS sent Nifty soaring 300 points in a minute to breach 23,000 on expiry day
items.description: Nifty surged more than 300 points in less than a minute during Tuesday’s closing auction session, briefly crossing 23,000 before paring gains. The sharp swings have renewed concerns over CAS volatility on expiry days, even as Sebi considers changes to derivatives settlement rules. Jefferies sees signs of recovery in options volumes.

items.title: LIC mints Rs 531 crore in one day as Trent shares rally 13%; insurance behemoth’s stake value nears Rs 4,700 cr
items.description: Trent shares rose sharply  after a strong Q2 business update, adding over Rs 17,540 crore to its market capitalisation. The surge lifted the value of LIC’s stake in the Zudio parent by more than Rs 531 crore in a single session. Trent also crossed 1,000 Zudio stores during the quarter.

items.title: Dabur shares rise 4% as firm sees double-digit Q2 growth; FMCG set for strong performance
items.description: Dabur shares rose sharply on Tuesday after the FMCG major projected double-digit consolidated revenue and PAT growth in Q2FY27. Its India FMCG business is expected to accelerate, while Home & Personal Care could post double-digit growth. Food and Beverages may deliver mid-teens growth, while international business is expected to maintain strong momentum.

items.title: Motilal Oswal initiates coverage on Molbio Diagnostics stock with Buy, sees 21% upside. Here's why
items.description: Motilal Oswal initiated coverage on Molbio Diagnostics with a Buy rating and ₹1,800 target, implying 21% upside. The brokerage sees strong growth potential from decentralised molecular diagnostics, led by Molbio’s Truenat platform, which has 12,500+ devices across 90+ countries and 43 assays for 30 diseases.

items.title: Indian banks face a Q2 paradox: FCNR boosts loan growth but margins shrink
items.description: Indian banks are heading into the Q2 earnings season with strong loan growth, helped by FCNR(B) deposit inflows, but margins are likely to remain under pressure. Analysts expect healthy earnings growth on lower credit costs and stable asset quality, while favouring large private banks such as HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank.

items.title: MFs kept buying these 10 microcaps for 2 straight quarters; stocks surge up to 70% in 3 months
items.description: Over the past two consecutive quarters, mutual funds have steadily increased their holdings in around 64 companies from the Nifty Microcap 250, through the June 2026 quarter. Such sustained accumulation often attracts the attention of retail investors, as MF investment decisions are typically backed by extensive research and detailed interactions with companies.

items.title: Meesho shares jump 6% as content commerce NMV grows 152% in Q2. Buy, sell or hold the stock?
items.description: Meesho shares rose after strong growth in its Content Commerce business, with NMV increasing 152% year-on-year. Brokerages remain divided, with UBS and Jefferies positive on the stock, while Nomura has a Reduce call.

items.title: These 8 banking stocks have an upside potential of up to 29% in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: For the last two years, one sector where actual performance has been better than expected has been banking. Yes, there were exceptions among small finance banks. But the question now is: Will the situation remain the same given that there are many emerging challenges?

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
items.description: Indian equities extended their rebound for a second session, with Sensex rising 685 points and Nifty gaining over 220 points. Falling crude prices, strong Q2 business updates and positive global cues lifted investor sentiment, adding nearly Rs 5 lakh crore to BSE market capitalisation.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Motilal Oswal among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday
items.description: Strong Q2 business updates from financials and retail companies along with supportive global cues, the decline in oil prices improved investors' sentiment and supported a rebound from the oversold levels. Domestically, attention now shifts to the Q2 earnings season for silver lining amidst weak sequential expectations due to elevated input costs. Analysts say large-cap stocks remain relatively better placed, supported by attractive valuations and a stronger ability to absorb cost pressures. Investors also remain cautious ahead of the RBI policy decision, with focus firmly on the central bank's inflation outlook and guidance on further policy tightening.Here are 4 stock recommendations that could offer good returns in the medium term

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A hospitality major for a 6.65% upmove, a mid-cap specialty chemicals stock for a gain of about 6%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.
